title: Nichiha Architectural Wall Panels AWP-1818/AWP-3030
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The CCMC fire table reports FSR 0 and SDC 10 under CAN/ULC-S102, with CAN/ULC-S134 flame-spread distance 2.5 m and heat flux 25.4 kW/m².
facts.locator: CCMC 14366-R PDF, p. 13, Fire performance table

facts.text: The CCMC report says the fire data is additional performance data outside its opinion and specifies a tested back-up wall of 16 mm Type X drywall, 51 × 102 mm wood studs, 16 mm plywood and 89 mm glass-fibre cavity insulation.
facts.locator: CCMC 14366-R PDF, p. 13, Fire performance notes

facts.text: Nichiha’s attached manufacturer test summary describes NRC Report A1-007541.1 and a separate CAN/ULC-S134 test assembly, including panel clips, 2×4 wood studs, gypsum, plywood, cavity insulation and Tyvek WRB.
facts.locator: Nichiha AWP Test Summaries, PDF p. 9 (printed p. 8)

limitations: Fire results are test-assembly specific and excluded from the CCMC opinion.
The original NRC report was referenced but not downloaded; the supplementary source is a manufacturer summary.
